component: CPU-only ASPIRE-inspired request-local draft-depth policy and offline trace replay prototype
modifications: Implemented the published acceptance estimator, exponential smoothing, expected-yield objective, and homogeneous batch-aware linear cost equations as an independent pure-Python policy model
Bound policy state per request and added fixed-depth and one-step feedback baselines
Added deterministic replay over counterfactual accepted-prefix observations and a synthetic CPU microbenchmark
Excluded unified mixed-forward execution, attention refresh, model/cache mutation, route registration, and qualification claims
Report normalized cost rather than hardware time; policy-dependent model-state trajectories are explicitly outside the replay model
validation: Focused CPU unit tests and the deterministic synthetic microbenchmark; no MLX, Metal, model artifact, GPU lease, or live service is used
